title: B. Cool-Aid Drops New Single "soundgood" Ahead of Highly Anticipated Album, Leather Blvd.
htmlContent:
B. Cool-Aid's signature smooth and mellow instrumentals blend jazz, soul, and hip-hop elements to create a tapestry of sounds that is both soothing and invigorating. B. Cool-Aid's "soundgood" featuring Pink Siifu, V.C.R, Jimetta Rose, Liv.e, and Ahwlee is a vibrant and sun-soaked jam that will uplift your spirits. The track is the final single ahead of the release of their highly anticipated album, Leather Blvd., which is set to drop on March 31st via Lex Records.

The album features a star-studded lineup of collaborations with friends like Ladybug Mecca (of Digable Planets), Big Rube, Fousheé, Mndsgn, Quelle Chris, Butcher Brown, and more. Alongside the album, B. Cool-Aid is announcing their Live in Leather tour, which includes select dates across North America and Europe.

Leather Blvd. showcases B. Cool-Aid's growth and evolution as artists while celebrating the community of musicians that brings their music to life. The album is like walking down a bustling street, with a diverse cast of established and up-and-coming artists lending their voices to create a rich and captivating sonic experience. "soundgood" is set to be a standout release in 2023.
